## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) and SPY/TLT ↑ rising confirm stocks over bonds while VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) signals easing fear; note HYG/LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↑ despite small gains in HYG (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +0.45%) ABOVE TREND.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX ↓ falling (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) BELOW TREND. Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising (SPY/TLT 1W: +3.31% | 1M: +2.45%) ABOVE TREND supports risk appetite, while CPER/GLD reflation ↑ rising (CPER RECOVERY (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%)) adds cyclical tilt; credit signal mixed with CREDIT STRESS ↑.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar weakness: Dollar Strength ↓ falling (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.87%) BELOW TREND. Long duration soft: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -0.35%) with yield curve → flat BELOW TREND, so financial conditions slightly looser but watch rate sensitivity.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and momentum leading: Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%) and Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%). Energy lagging: Energy XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) and Communication BELOW TREND (1W: -0.86% | 1M: -2.74%); style: Growth/Momentum leadership confirmed by sector breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperformance: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.46% | 1M: +0.68%). EM strength: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%), China FXI RECOVERY (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -0.41%) — Europe tracking higher: VGK (Europe proxy) ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +2.65%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation easing: Speculation Index ↓ falling (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND but pockets of risk-on remain — IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +3.72%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +3.53%) show active risk-taking; ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +1.06% | 1M: -5.17%) signals selective speculative flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/reflation tilt: CPER RECOVERY (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) and copper/Gold ratio ↑ rising support cyclical demand. Volatile oil signals: USO CORRECTION (1W: -9.50% | 1M: +15.52%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%) — commodities mixed but biased toward reflation themes.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed to weak: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) with Brent BNO CORRECTION (1W: -12.69% | 1M: +7.29%). Natural gas remains weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) — watch seasonality and supply swings.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad equity advance with SPY, QQQ, IWM ABOVE TREND and 9/11 sectors positive. DIVERGENCE: Commodity/energy ETFs show 1W weakness vs 1M gains (USO, BNO, XLE) — minor-to-moderate divergence, monitor for mean reversion.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and momentum exposure: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%), EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.02% | 1M: +2.94%). Reduce exposure to high-volatility natural gas and idiosyncratic commodity shorts: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) and watch XLE CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.88% | 1M: +1.69%) and Financials XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +5.51%). BEARISH: Energy XLE CORRECTION (1W: -3.90% | 1M: +0.58%) and Communication BELOW TREND (1W: -0.86% | 1M: -2.74%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial reflation via CPER RECOVERY (1W: +4.36% | 1M: -0.69%) and select oil exposure if price stabilizes after USO/BNO corrections. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.11% | 1M: -16.38%) and broader commodity dispersion remains a risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) — current VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%); HYG/LQD ~0.75–0.80 (credit health marker) — HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +0.61%), LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +0.45%); XLK/XLF ratio ~2.0 for growth vs value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +0.74%) and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -4.62%) confirming broad risk appetite. Technology (XLK ABOVE TREND) and Financials (XLF ABOVE TREND) are showing strength. Key risk: energy/commodity divergences (USO/BNO/XLE CORRECTION and UNG BELOW TREND) that could re-test leadership if crude and gas resume directional moves.
